subject: Request: runtime KEK rotation artifacts and witness logs for SIG review
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@silverline.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@silverline.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — KEK rotation/runtime wrapping artifacts

Hi Logan,

As part of our SIG + internal controls review for the upcoming contract renewal, Silverline needs artifacts demonstrating how you perform live KEK rotations for runtime wrapping/unwrapping. Specifically we need: 

- A rotation manifest with timestamps and operator IDs for the last two scheduled rotations;
- Signed witness logs showing successful wrap/unwrap operations during a rotation;
- Sanitized test vectors (ciphertext + plaintext pairs) and a short verification runbook we can run offline;
- Hash/checksum of any bundles you provide and SFTP delivery receipt.

Can you confirm whether you can produce those items and if HSM attestation (vendor certs) will be included? Our audit window for SIG evidence delivery is two weeks from today — target date 2027-11-15.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Liu
Senior Compliance Manager, Silverline Financial
emma.liu@silverline.com

(attachment: SIG-evidence-request-2027-11-01.pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@silverline.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request — KEK rotation/runtime wrapping artifacts

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. We can produce the artifacts you listed. High-level plan:

1) Deliver a signed artifact bundle via SFTP (or Hub Drive link, pick your preference). The bundle will include a rotation manifest, signed witness logs, wrap_test_vectors (sanitized), and a signed checksum file.
2) We will redact tenant-identifying fields from logs; anything Silverline-specific can be provided in a separate, more narrowly scoped export under NDA if needed.
3) HSM attestation: we can include the vendor attestation PDF for our HSM fleet (FIPS/HSM vendor certs). If you require an on-site attestation or a more formal attestation letter, let us know so we can route to Ops.

Timeline: we will assemble an initial bundle and aim to upload by EOD 2027-11-03. If you need earlier or a staged delivery to start validation sooner, we can push partial artifacts.

Questions for you: do you want the wrap_test_vectors to include raw ephemeral KEK material (we normally avoid sharing raw key material) or only ciphertext/plaintext pairs and the deterministic inputs used for the test harness? Also confirm preferred delivery (SFTP path or shared Drive).

Irene and Marissa — looping you in to pull the artifact set and prepare the witness signatures.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com

(attachment: none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request — KEK rotation/runtime wrapping artifacts

Following up with what we'll include in the bundle:

- kek_rotation_manifest.csv — columns: rotation_id, start_ts, end_ts, operator_id (redacted), model_variant, impacted_pools, verification_status;
- rotation_witness.log (signed) — runtime service logs around rotation events with KV cache flush markers and wrap/unwrap success codes;
- wrap_test_vectors.jsonl — sanitized vector set (ciphertext, associated metadata, expected plaintext) — no raw KEK material;
- rotation_witness_signature.sig — detached signature over the bundle (RSA-PSS, SHA256);
- SFTP_transfer_receipt.txt — server-side receipt and file checksums.

We will also prepare an HSM attestation package (vendor cert + statement of applicability) as a separate file. For audit scoping: we'll redact operator email/IDs to role-only identifiers (e.g., operator-03). If Silverline wants unredacted operator traceability, we'll need a narrow-scope export and a signed access agreement.

DocuSign attestation: we can provide an attestation letter and route it through DocuSign if the auditor needs an authorized signature.

Irene: can you ensure the detached signature and checksum are generated using our rotation key stores (not the ephemeral test harness)?

Marissa
Principal, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

(attachments planned: kek_rotation_manifest.csv, wrap_test_vectors.jsonl, rotation_witness_signature.sig)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@silverline.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@silverline.com, Audits Team <audits@bluevault.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request — KEK rotation/runtime wrapping artifacts

Logan / Marissa — that plan sounds good. A few clarifications before you produce the bundle: 

- We do NOT need raw KEKs. Ciphertext/plaintext pairs and deterministic inputs are sufficient.
- Please include the verification runbook with exact commands we should run to validate the vectors (example: how to call the unwrap endpoint against a known payload, expected status codes, and timeouts).
- Please include a single detached checksum (SHA256) file per bundle and annotate the manifest with the checksum value and the signature key id.
- Delivery: SFTP is preferred. We will provide an inbound path if you confirm upload size (<500MB).

If you can target 2027-11-03 EOD for the upload, we will begin validation the following week. Also cc'ing BlueVault audits in case they want to triage technical questions directly.

Thanks — Emma

(attachment: Silverline-evidence-guidance.pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@silverline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request — KEK rotation/runtime wrapping artifacts

Hi Emma — bundle uploaded to SFTP and receipts attached below. Thank you for the clarifications; we implemented them in the manifest and runbook. Delivery summary: 

SFTP path: sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/incoming/silverline/kek-20271103/
Files included:
- kek_rotation_manifest.csv (see manifest_manifest_checksum.txt)
- wrap_test_vectors.jsonl (sanitized, includes ciphertext/plaintext, nonce metadata, and expected validation steps)
- rotation_witness.log (trimmed to rotation windows; operator IDs redacted to role tags)
- rotation_witness_signature.sig (detached RSA-PSS signature over the bundle)
- SFTP_transfer_receipt.txt (server-side receipt + SHA256 checksums)

We used bundle signature key id: sig-k-07 (public key previously shared under your Key Exchange). Checksum (SHA256): 3a7f5c9b8d4f6a... (full checksum in SFTP_transfer_receipt.txt).

Next steps: Silverline validation team can run the verification runbook included in the bundle. If you require a DocuSign attestation letter signed by our Head of Ops, reply and we'll route the envelope. For any technical questions during validation, Ben Carter (cc) will act as the day-to-day contact (ben.carter@redwood.com).

Regards,
Logan Wright
Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com

Attachments: kek_rotation_manifest.csv (stub), wrap_test_vectors.jsonl (stub), rotation_witness_signature.sig (stub), SFTP_transfer_receipt.txt (stub)
